data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 6.1m (2020: favourable development of GBP 11.6m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate noted potential limited exposure; maintained a net reserve booked in 2020 against potential claims of GBP 2.0m.
May face some indirect exposure in Financial Lines and Cyber; caused volatility in equity and bond markets to which parts of the investment portfolio have exposure.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year release driven by favourable development in older underwriting years. Using the gross claims development triangle (gross basis), there is an aggregate gross release of approximately GBP 13.1m, mainly reflecting favourable development across older casualty years, partially offset by adverse movement in one of the more recent prior years. The managing agent's narrative attributes releases principally to direct third party liability business and to reinsurance acceptances, with a small strengthening in Other direct.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 6.1m (2020: favourable development of GBP 11.6m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 6.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.9m in respect of total Reinsurance business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 3.7m in Other direct.

The Management Adjustment in excess of the best estimate of net reserves was GBP 37.1m (2020: GBP 31.4m). This level of Management Adjustment is considered appropriate in light of the current economic environment, loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses, and the potential for second order COVID related losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle because the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note reported only net (after reinsurance) movement. A Part VII transfer and associated quota-share reinsurance took place in Dec 2020 but the report states the combined effect had no economic impact; nonetheless users should note the corporate transfers and reinsurance arrangements when comparing gross and net movements.
